title: Character-first visual production V1
description: Add a character-first semi-automatic visual workflow for new projects, including versioned channel teacher characters, semantic asset concepts, prompt locking, bounded shot rhythm, motion metadata, and MP4/CapCut preview output while preserving legacy projects.
businessContext: The current pipeline can review shot assets but cannot persist a consistent channel character, map visual assets to semantic beats, or carry motion intent into preview and CapCut output. New videos need more varied visuals without breaking existing projects.
dependencies: existing FFmpeg preview and CapCut packaging paths
acceptanceCriteria: New projects default to the character-first visual workflow and persist the selected approved character version; legacy projects continue using their existing stage graph.
A channel character version supports configurable teacher persona data, a 4-6 view identity pack with default five views, per-view retry, approval, active-version selection, and safe preview URLs.
Visual stages cannot run for character-first projects until an approved character version is bound to the project.

Asset Concepts produce validated per-semantic-beat asset cards and optional references before Prompt Preparation; the stage auto-advances after validation and retries failed items without placeholders.
Prompt Preparation includes the character prompt lock, invariant traits, asset concepts, semantic beat, and motion intent and returns exactly one prompt for each AI shot.
Shot planning targets 2-4 second visual beats, allows up to 5 seconds when necessary, and enforces a maximum of 20 AI-generated images per minute by reusing assets when appropriate.
Motion metadata is restricted to the V1 effect catalog, can be overridden per shot, is approximated in FFmpeg preview, and is included in CapCut/export metadata.
Provider failures stop at needs_attention with item-scoped retry and never insert placeholder media or expose raw secrets/errors.
Focused domain, service, persistence, renderer, preview, and packaging tests plus typecheck and git diff check pass.

humanEscalationConditions: The existing provider API cannot safely generate the required identity or asset references without a forbidden provider-surface change.
CapCut or FFmpeg cannot carry the V1 motion metadata without changing forbidden bridge code.
Existing dirty changes prevent a safe bounded edit in an allowed path.
